rules.name: Route by delivery software
rules.rule: Identify whether the task is an AE project, Rive state machine, Cavalry node scene, or Cupric native scene before choosing techniques. Do not silently replace an editable native deliverable with a flattened video.

rules.name: Break references into observable beats
rules.rule: Measure duration, frame rate, aspect ratio, shot boundaries, direction, spacing, counts, proportions, holds, speed peaks, transitions and end states before styling. Compare matching timestamps, not arbitrary frame numbers.

rules.name: Use native editable objects
rules.rule: Keep text, paths, shapes, controls, keyframes, state machines and repeated relationships editable. A large script or flattened screenshot is not equivalent to user-facing editability.

rules.name: Share repeated motion controls
rules.rule: Use one master progress, duplicator, array, state value or timeline controller for repeated motion; keep genuinely independent actions independent. Do not expand every copy into opaque keyframes.

rules.name: Fix motion before polish
rules.rule: When a result feels wrong, check direction, pivot, layer distance, count, spacing, expansion, settle and speed curve before adding grain, shadow or extra effects.

rules.name: Discover properties before writing
rules.rule: Enumerate effect properties, match names, ports, renderers, inputs and current values before changing them. Do not trust numeric indexes, old coordinates, or a similarly named property.

rules.name: Separate open/save from render
rules.rule: Open the confirmed project, verify the correct file and visible frame, save it, then render in a separate step. Do not treat a generated script or queued job as proof of a rendered result.

rules.name: Review decoded output
rules.rule: Decode the actual output, check dimensions, frame count, timestamps, audio and key action frames, then compare the motion at matching times. A thumbnail or metadata-only check is insufficient.

rules.name: State evidence honestly
rules.rule: Distinguish file written, app opened, project saved, native-rendered, decoded and compared. Record unconfirmed causes as unconfirmed instead of claiming a professional result from a script exit code.

rules.name: Continue from the accepted baseline
rules.rule: When adding a new segment, find the newest accepted project, preserve accepted work, confirm its end frame and current controls, and change only the requested range before extending the scene.
